name: template comment quoting the marker
text:
_Rewritten weekly._

<!-- The dashboard can show Current state in two panes. They are one message: everything above the line `<!-- creaite: second pane -->` is the left pane and everything below it the right pane. Without that line the whole text is the left pane. Every reader (the weekly and client reports, Generate, search) reads the two as one continuous message; keep the marker and the right pane when you rewrite this section. -->
why: the project template's guidance comment whole (BL-310 keeps it in one pane): it quotes the marker inside it
